decisions.reason: Replacing a blog keyword with "crochet flower" does not necessarily change the selected blog topics.
The source changes a blog keyword, not the separately maintained 20-keyword campaign selection or its mapped replacement keyword.
The keyword replacement does not change the requirement to produce and publish three blog articles within the trial.
The source does not change the standing requirement to include search-volume metrics in the keyword research sheet or establish that the blog keyword belongs to that sheet.
